# Booked Out Solutions

> Booked Out Solutions helps local service businesses across the US get found and get booked: calls answered, quotes followed up, reviews answered, and Google and ChatGPT listings kept current. Start with a free report on where you stand.

- Owner: Rickey Hallor, Smyrna, Tennessee (licensed business)
- Phone: (615) 821-1607, answered day and night
- Email: hello@getbookedoutsolutions.com
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm Central
- Serves: local service businesses anywhere in the US (heating and air, plumbing, electrical and other trades), by phone, email and online
- How to start: a free report on the business's Google listing, reviews and quotes, then 30 free days of work before any payment
- Terms: no long-term contract, billed every 30 days, cancel with one reply

## What we do

- Old and new quotes followed up in the shop's own voice
- Every inquiry answered the same day
- Google reviews asked for after every job and every review replied to
- Google Business Profile filled in and posted on weekly
- ChatGPT business listing set up and kept current
- AI phone receptionist that answers when the owner can't, and says it's an AI
- Websites, postcards, Google Ads and a Friday report on what was done and what it brought in
